x: Expansion Plus Expansion Plus is the all-in-one add-on for DayZ Expansion servers. Banking, a stock exchange, a full vehicle garage, player shops, territory rent, courier jobs, bounties, conflict zones, messaging and the Workshop survival tools, all on one in-game device: the Ghostz Tab 10.1 . Admins run everything from the same tablet. The tablet's home screen groups every app into hubs: Hub Apps Finance Bank , Stock Exchange Garage Garage , Taxi , Rentals & Tracker , Vehicle Dashboard Workshop Inventory , Crafting , Repair , Drying , Appraisal Trade Player shops , Donations Jobs Courier contracts and quests , Bounties Territory Territory rent , Conflict zones Intel Loot Scanner Social Messages , notifications, leaderboards, reviews, server info

The server builds every screen and checks every click. Players can't fake money, prices or items. Every file is saved with a verified backup. Damaged files are kept aside, never reset. Every charge and refund lands in the player's Transactions .
Getting started

Mod Workshop ID Why Community Framework CF 1559212036 Core framework, file access Dabs Framework 2545327648 Needed by Expansion's UI DayZ-Expansion-Licensed 2116157322 Expansion core DayZ-Expansion-Bundle 2572331007 Market, Base Building and Navigation are used Note The Expansion ATM must be on. Set "ATMSystemEnabled": 1 in profiles/ExpansionMod/Settings/MarketSettings.json . Banking, shops, rent, fees and online pay all use the Expansion bank.

Copy @GhostzSuite into your server folder. Copy @GhostzSuite/keys/Ghostz.bikey into the server's keys folder. Load it last , after Expansion and after any PvE mod: -mod=@CF;@Dabs Framework;@DayZ-Expansion-Licensed;@DayZ-Expansion-Bundle;@GhostzSuite Start the server once. It creates profiles/GhostzSuite/ and profiles/GhostzQoLPlus/ . Warning Do not load @GhostzQoLPlus 1.20 or later or @GhostzAbandonedShop 1.21 or later with Expansion Plus. Their code is already inside, and loading both stops the server starting.
Players subscribe on the Steam Workshop ID 3832964217 . The tablet, map drawing and sounds run on each player's game, so players always need the same version as the server .

Start the server once. It creates profiles/GhostzSuite/Settings.json . Stop the server and add your Steam64 ID to Admins : json "Admins": "76561198000000000" Start the server, join and press F8 . After that, add or remove admins in game on F8 → SETTINGS ADD MY ID adds yourself . Admins in Expansion Plus are admins of the Workshop apps too. If someone who isn't an admin presses F8, the panel shows them their Steam64 ID so they can send it to you. Narrower roles are covered in Admin panel .

Players open a shop with a shop kit . There are three: GZS PlayerShopKit Abandoned Shop , GZS PlayerShopKit Little Little Shop and GZS PlayerShopKit Market Minimarket . The quickest way is the ready-made market category and types.xml entries in the mod's Extras folder. Or add them by hand: Press F8 and open MARKET . Edit a category and add the kit classnames, with a price and stock. Make sure that category is in a trader, then restart.

Key Does F7 The tablet F5 The tablet, open on the Workshop hub F8 Admin panel admins only F9 Server info K Garage Numpad 0 Cruise control while driving Mouse wheel up Boat radar on / off in a boat Esc Back inside an app , or closes the tablet All keys can be changed under Options → Controls → Expansion Plus .

While driving a car, motorbike or boat, press the cruise key to hold your speed. Up / Down arrow change it by 5 km/h hold to keep changing . The cruise key again, the brake, the handbrake, reversing a boat, stopping the engine or leaving the seat turn it off. Accelerating still speeds you up, and cruise picks up again when you let go.
In a boat, a small round radar sits in the bottom-right corner: 500 m range, heading-up, with a sweep line. Vehicles show orange, people white, boats blue. Mouse wheel up turns it on or off.
Updating
Expansion Plus 1.21.0 brings Ghostz Shops inside: player shops are now buildings. Nothing is wiped.

Back up profiles/GhostzSuite . Update @GhostzSuite . Remove @GhostzAbandonedShop from the server's -mod list and from your modlist or launcher. Keep keys/Ghostz.bikey same key . Add the shop kits to your market: GZS PlayerShopKit Abandoned Shop , GZS PlayerShopKit Little Little Shop and GZS PlayerShopKit Market Minimarket . A ready-made market category and types.xml entries are in the Extras folder. Existing GZS PlayerShopKit market entries keep working. Restart. Settings files are updated with the new defaults automatically.

At the first start, every old container shop is packed up automatically . Each shop keeps its stock, funds, ratings and name . The container is removed and the owner gets a shop kit at their next login. Placing the kit opens the shop again. See Player shops .

Garage tow anywhere and vehicles kept across restarts off / on by default respectively : see Garage and Settings . Vehicle snapshots are saved in profiles/GhostzSuite/Garage/out/ old ones are cleaned up automatically .
Expansion Plus 1.20.0 brings Ghostz QoL Plus inside: one mod, one tablet, one admin panel. Nothing is wiped.

Back up profiles/GhostzSuite and profiles/GhostzQoLPlus . Update @GhostzSuite . Remove @GhostzQoLPlus from the server's -mod list and from your modlist or launcher. Keep keys/Ghostz.bikey same key as 1.18 . Restart. Warning Loading @GhostzQoLPlus together with Expansion Plus 1.20 stops the server starting, because the same code would be loaded twice.

Players unsubscribe from Ghostz QoL Plus and update Expansion Plus. Their tablet background and message sound are kept.

The Ghostz Tab 10.1 Press F7 to pick up the tablet. It's a physical device: an aluminium rim, black glass, Ghostz Tab 10.1 printed on the top bezel with the camera beside it, power and volume buttons on the top edge, and three keys on the bottom bezel.

Key Does ◁ Back Goes to the previous screen. Inside an app, its own sub-panel closes first ○ Home Goes to the home screen ▷ Forward Goes to the screen you just came back from The keys light up under the mouse. History covers the home screen, hubs, every app page Bank, Garage... , the Workshop apps and admin pages. Esc also goes back inside an app.

Status bar : clock, your bank and cash, and whether rent and rentals are paid from BANK or CASH. Header : your name and live water, temperature, health, food and stamina squares, refreshed every 2 seconds. Left menu : Home, Settings, Help, About, Links, Logout. Hubs : one big tile per hub. A hub with only one app opens that app straight away for example the Loot Scanner . Quick Status : a strip with anything worth acting on, such as new messages, crafted items ready to collect, or the loot scanner ready or recharging. Stat bars along the bottom. Hub Apps Finance Banking, Stock Exchange Garage

The Workshop apps and the Loot Scanner and Vehicle Dashboard open inside the tablet's own screen : the header shows the app's name, messages appear in the status bar, and the bezel keys work as usual. F5 opens the tablet on the Workshop hub.

Left menu → Settings holds each player's own choices: Background – 12 pictures to choose from, including Misty Peaks and Dragon Dusk new in 1.21 . Pay from bank or cash – SWITCH BANK / CASH sets where rent, rentals and Workshop fees are paid from first. Player shops always use bank transfer. New message sound – OFF, the Expansion Plus chime default or one of 24 game sounds. PLAY previews a sound. Tip The background and message sound are saved in your own game, so they stay the same on every server running Expansion Plus.

Left menu → Links opens the Expansion Plus Workshop page and the server's own links Donate, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, Kick and any others . Admins set them in F8 → INFO → TABLET LINKS BUTTON .
The tablet is designed at 1080p and scales to 1440p, 4K, ultrawide and smaller screens.

Garage → vehicle → 3D VIEW shows the vehicle with its parts fitted, plus owner, condition, value, fluids, parts and cargo. Drag to turn, mouse wheel to zoom. Shops and donations have a 3D button on each item with its weight, size, capacity and description.
Bank and online pay Finance → Banking. The bank is the player's Expansion bank, the same money the ATMs use. No ATM is needed to use it from the tablet.

Bank limit: 500,000,000 for player and group accounts setting BankMaxBalance . Expansion's own default is 100,000; Expansion Plus raises it at start-up and checks it every minute. DEPOSIT CASH / WITHDRAW CASH anywhere. Savings – a second account paying 10% every 24 hours , compounding. PUT IN SAVINGS / TAKE OUT . Group account – one per Expansion group. OPEN GROUP ACCOUNT , then any member can PAY IN or TAKE OUT , and the group sees the last moves. SEND MONEY – find any player, online or offline, and send them money from your bank. Take one for 1, 2, 4 or 7 days and pay it back with 35% on top . Borrow from the bank – up to 100,000 , with 50% on top , for the same times. PAY BACK NOW at any time. Otherwise, on the due date the money is taken from your bank, then your savings. Can't pay? Players are paid into their bank for time online . Setting Default Pay players for time online On Pay per hour online 500 Pay out every 60 minutes 30 = half the hourly pay every 30 minutes Tell the player On Each payment shows in the bank transactions as Online pay . Admins change these in F8 → SETTINGS → ONLINE PAY . Note If another mod on your server also pays for time online, turn one of them off so players don't get two messages.

F8 → BANKING : every rate and limit, banking on or off, bank loans and group accounts on or off, a savings cap, totals, running loans with CANCEL DEBT and the bank log. Saved in profiles/GhostzSuite/Bank.json .
Survivor Stock Exchange Finance → Stock Exchange or Banking → OPEN EXCHANGE opens a trading terminal with 24 fictional companies , each with a logo, industry, risk rating, description and dividend.

Prices move every market hour 60 minutes by default , even while the server is empty, and catch up after a restart up to a week . Each step moves a share at most 4% , and a share stays between 0.25× and 2.5× its company's normal value. Chernarus Business Wire : 2–3 big stories a week. Their effect spreads over hours and is never guaranteed, and rival companies feel it too. Market-wide booms, recessions and crashes .

Screen What it shows Market News ticker, the SSX index chart, today's risers and fallers Companies Every company with price and change Company page Chart, stats, BUY / SELL with confirmation, WATCH My Portfolio Holdings, average price, realised and unrealised profit Market News Every story Watchlist Companies you watch Transactions Your trades and payments Top Investors The ranking

Pay in from your bank and take out to your bank. Orders cost a small fee 0.5% by default . Dividends are paid weekly. Limits by default: 100,000 per deposit and per order, 2,000,000 in one account. Note The server decides every price and trade. Orders are checked, limited and handled one at a time.
F8 → STOCK EXCHANGE : every setting, publish a news story, trigger a crash or boom, update now, edit or delist companies. Settings are in profiles/GhostzSuite/Stocks/Settings.json reference .
Garage Garage → Garage EP Garage Services , or press K . Store your vehicles safely, take them out where you need them, and buy, sell, repair and insure them.

STORE VEHICLE stores a vehicle of yours within 12 m , with its parts, fluids, damage and cargo exactly as they were. Park vehicle garage in the scroll menu parks the vehicle you're looking at, with the same rules. TAKE OUT brings it back at a spot you aim at, 4 to 15 m away boats need water and get double the range . Taking a vehicle out never deletes its saved file until the garage has saved. If anything fails, the vehicle stays safely in the garage. Vehicles come out with the fluid levels they were parked with , standing on top of slabs, ramps or floors never under them . A vehicle that drop

Admins can require parking and taking out to happen in parking zones or at your territory flag. Parking and dealer zones show on the Expansion map with the parking icon, the zone's name and a ring round the zone, but they don't clutter the map legend . You get a message when you enter or leave one.

Lock vehicle / Unlock vehicle in the scroll menu look at the vehicle, press F . Auto lock after the owner has been more than 10 m away for 60 seconds . A locked vehicle offers nobody Get in , and its doors and inventory can't be opened from outside. Admins can still get in. A vehicle nobody owns becomes its first driver's when they sit in the driver's seat. Works on cars, boats and the DayZ 1.30 motorbikes. Admins can switch to Expansion car keys VehicleLockSystem = keys or turn locks off off .

Group sharing is on by default : anyone in the owner's Expansion group can take out, store and drive the owner's vehicles, including ones a teammate stored. Selling, giving and insuring stay with the owner. You can also share a vehicle with up to 5 other players. Admins can turn group sharing off NoPartySharing to go back to per-vehicle sharing.

Dealer – buy and sell vehicles at Expansion market prices at any trader 50 m . Damage and missing parts come off the price. Player market – list a stored vehicle for other players to buy 3 listings each by default . Give a vehicle to another player.

Service What it does Service Body repair, worn part repair, fluid top-up, ruined part replacement Valet Frees a vehicle tied to a zone 10,000 Bring vehicle Brings your vehicle to you 25 m radius, 60 s cooldown Repair callout Fully repairs a broken-down vehicle where it is 25,000, fuel not included Insurance 25% of the value; get the vehicle back if it's destroyed

Towing outside parking areas : vehicles left outside parking areas get towed after 120 minutes unused, with a fee and a warning. Tow anywhere : admins can set GARAGE → SETTINGS → TOWING → Tow anywhere after minutes unused . Any vehicle left unused that long is towed to its owner's garage, even inside a parking area , and needs a release fee a flat amount and / or a % of the vehicle's value to take out. 0 = off. The owner is warned before the tow , and players see "towed in ..." for their vehicles. Restarts don't affect it : unused time only counts while the server is up and is saved, so a rest

Every vehicle out in the world is snapshotted every 10 minutes position, parts, cargo, fluids . After a restart, a vehicle that fell through the ground or got flung away is put back where it was left. A vehicle that didn't come back at all is rebuilt from its snapshot, and the owner is told. Tracked vehicles never time out of the game's storage 45 days, topped up automatically , including modded vehicles that aren't in types.xml . Vehicles driven far from their last saved spot are found again anywhere on the map instead of being marked lost. All of this is in GARAGE → SETTINGS → VEHICLES IN TH
TAXI takes you to a stop or a spot on the map: see Taxi . Garage → Dashboard shows the vehicle you're in: see Vehicle Dashboard . Cruise control and the boat radar are on Getting started .
Taxi Garage → TAXI. Ride to a taxi stop or, if the server allows it, to any spot on the map.

Click a stop on the map or in the list, or click any spot and press SET DESTINATION HERE → CHOOSE THIS SPOT . The fare and distance are shown. Press TAKE THE TAXI . Your vehicle within reach is parked in the garage first at the nearest parking zone , if the server has that on. You're set down on solid, dry ground at the stop, never inside an object or in water. Fare = the stop's fare or the base fare plus the price per km. There's a wait between rides 120 seconds by default .

On by default. Rides under 300 m are refused. No map rides within 2 km of an Expansion trader or a point of interest from the map's own place list military bases, airfields, prisons and similar . Towns and villages are always fine. Admins can add NO-TAXI AREAS where map rides can't end. Note Every check happens again when you press TAKE THE TAXI, before any money moves. Nothing is charged if anything fails.

GARAGE ADMIN → TAXI : add stops where you stand or by typed X Y Z, name them, give each its own fare, MOVE HERE , teleport to them or remove them. Set the fares, ride-anywhere options, points of interest and no-taxi areas. See the taxi settings .
Vehicle rental and tracker

Garage → Rentals EP Rent-a-Ride . Stand within 50 m of any trader or inside any Expansion trader zone , or rent straight into your garage and take it out later. RENT is always clickable and tells you why if you can't rent where you are. Admins choose which market vehicles can be rented, for how long and at what price. Rentals come out full : fuel, oil, brake fluid, coolant and a charged battery , with every part, and a paired key if the server uses Expansion car keys. You're warned 5 minutes before the time runs out. When it ends, the vehicle is removed, so don't leave loot in it . Your rental

Garage → Tracker. Sit in the driver's seat and press TRACK THIS VEHICLE . Tracked vehicles appear on your Expansion map and follow the vehicle. Each one can be a 2D marker map only or a 3D marker map and in the world . Tracking stops by itself when the vehicle is parked, towed, impounded or destroyed, and you're told why. Up to 3 tracked vehicles by default. STOP removes one.

Vehicle Dashboard Garage → Dashboard. Sit in a vehicle and open the dashboard to see: Condition of the vehicle. Fuel, oil, brake fluid and coolant levels as bars. PARTS STATUS : every part slot, installed, MISSING or damaged. OPEN VEHICLE CARGO opens the vehicle's cargo in the Inventory app. Admins choose whether passengers can use it, and whether fluids and parts are shown Vehicles.json .
Inventory Manager Workshop → Inventory. Your gear, nearby storage and the cargo of the vehicle you're in, as icon grids.

The SOURCES list holds everything you can reach: You : what you wear and carry worn items count only for your own inventory . Nearby storage : tents, barrels, crates and other containers within 3 m , in line of sight. Vehicle cargo : the vehicle you're sitting in drivers only while it stands still . Stashes, other players and locked storage vanilla and Expansion locks are never listed.

Click items to select several, pick a target in TRANSFER TO , then TRANSFER > . STACK ALL merges partial stacks. SPLIT splits a stack. SORT : by name, quantity or condition. Search by name. REFRESH reloads. The server checks reach, line of sight, locks and room for every item, one at a time, the same way the game's own inventory does.

Inventory.json : radius 1–10 m , line of sight, nearby containers, vehicle cargo, nearby unlocked vehicles, drivers only while stationary, most items listed, and containers that are never accessible. See the reference .

Crafting Workshop Workshop → Crafting. Make items from recipes the admins set up. Pick a recipe from RECIPES filter by CATEGORY . REQUIRED MATERIALS shows each ingredient as have / need , and any TOOL needed tools aren't used up . CRAFT takes the materials and the cost bank or cash , then the product is made. If the recipe takes time, it appears under IN PROGRESS / READY TO COLLECT . Press TAKE PRODUCT when it's ready. Tip Crafted items wait safely on the server until you collect them, even through restarts. The tablet's Quick Status tells you when one is ready.

Recipes are built in game: F8 → QOL tab → RECIPES . Each recipe has a name, category, ingredients and tools with an ITEM BROWSER over every game and mod item , the output item, count, quantity and condition, a time, and a cost. Recipes can be admin-only or switched off. DUPLICATE , PREVIEW and DELETE are there too. Saved in CraftingRecipes.json .

Repair Workshop Workshop → Repair. Repair your damaged gear up the damage ladder. DAMAGED ITEMS ON YOU lists everything that's below pristine. Pick an item and choose REPAIR TO : DAMAGED , WORN or PRISTINE . The cost money and any items for each step is shown. REPAIR ITEM pays and repairs. Step Default cost Badly damaged → Damaged 500 Damaged → Worn 1,000 Worn → Pristine 2,000 One repair can climb up to 3 steps. Ruined items can't be repaired by default. Every result is checked by the server, and if a repair fails after paying, the money is refunded.

Repairs.json : which kinds can be repaired weapons, clothing, other, ruined , attachments repaired too, steps per repair, cost and items per step e.g. DuctTape:1, Rag:2 , a wait per step, and classes never repaired.

Drying Station Workshop → Drying. A real washer-dryer for your wet gear. WET ITEMS ON YOU shows your wet clothing and gear with how wet each is. Click items to load them or SELECT ALL . They tumble in the drum, and the LCD shows how many items are loaded. DRY ITEMS pays the fee if any , the drum spins up and the LCD counts down, then shows END . Only the wetness is changed; everything else about the items is kept. LCD Means --:-- Empty 3 ITEMS Loaded, ready 00:03 Drying END Done WAIT 20 The dryer is cooling down Defaults: free, up to 10 items per load, 30 seconds between uses. Admins set these

Gear Appraisal Workshop → Appraisal shows what your gear is worth at the server's Expansion traders: INVENTORY VALUE : the total. BY CATEGORY : subtotals. ITEMS HIGHEST VALUE FIRST : every item with its value, and how many items no trader buys. RECALCULATE refreshes it. Prices come from the Expansion market on the server. Admins choose whether attachments and items inside containers are counted Valuation.json .

Player shops Trade → Shops / My Shop. Players run their own shop buildings that other players buy from and sell to. Note Ghostz Shops is built into Expansion Plus since 1.21.0. Don't load @GhostzAbandonedShop as well. Old container shops are packed up automatically: see Updating to 1.21 .

There are three shop buildings, each with working doors and a storage chest inside: Building Kit classname Abandoned Shop GZS PlayerShopKit the old kit class, so existing market entries keep working Little Shop GZS PlayerShopKit Little Minimarket GZS PlayerShopKit Market A ready-made market category and types.xml entries for the kits are in the mod's Extras folder.

Buy a shop kit from a trader. Take it in your hands and toggle placement. A blueprint of the building follows you green = OK, red = blocked . Turn it with the mouse wheel , raise or lower it with Numpad 8 / Numpad 2 , then place it. Claim it by naming it : look at the shop's sign and use Name your shop . The name shows on the sign, the tablet and the map. Only the owner can rename it admins can too, for names that break the rules .

Every shop has a storage chest . Only the owner can take items out by hand. Items customers buy appear in the storage, held for them. They collect them with TAKE MY ITEMS . STOCK FROM STORAGE owners adds what you put in the chest to your stock.

Customers pay from their bank, and sellers are paid into their bank. Cash is never used. Everything customers pay goes straight into the owner's bank. Every shop starts with 100,000 in funds for buying items from players. Starting funds can be spent but never withdrawn. Owners move money with BANK → SHOP and SHOP → BANK .

Stocked items are saved in the shop's file. Accepted items: Worn or better, empty, nothing attached, magazines unloaded, no spoiled food. Field Meaning Sell price What customers pay for one 0 = not for sale Buy price What the shop pays for one 0 = not buying Buy up to The shop stops buying at this much stock MAIL TO SHOP sends items from anywhere into your shop not within 60 seconds of combat . WHOLESALE buys stock from the Expansion market at 15% off 20% off for 10 or more .

Put items in the shop's storage or sell straight from your inventory and choose who buys: Button Who pays SELL TO SHOP The owner buys it at their price, paid from the shop's funds SELL TO TRADER The shop's trader categories buy it, paid by the server SELL ALL BEST PRICE Sells each item to whichever pays more Both prices are shown side by side.

F8 → SHOPS → a shop : switch any Expansion trader category on, for example Medicals on one shop and Weapons on another. Players can then sell that shop anything those traders sell. Trader term per shop Meaning Seller gets % Of the Expansion sell price, paid by the server. The owner can change it within the limits you set ShopTraderPayMin / ShopTraderPayMax Owner gets % The owner's cut of every trader sale -1 = the server default, ShopTraderCommission Owner keeps sold items On: the items become the shop's stock. Off: they go to the server

SHOPS lists every shop with what it sells and buys, its rating and location, with tabs by Expansion trader. Buying and selling only work at the shop. Anywhere else, the shop is view-only. Rate a shop 1 to 5 after trading with it. TOP SHOPS ranks them.
Use a screwdriver at the front door or PACK UP SHOP on the tablet . You get the kit back and everything stock, funds, ratings, name is kept for when you place it again.
Donations, players and server info

Trade → Donations. Near any trader 50 m , donate items you don't need, or take one free item every 5 minutes . You can't take back your own donations. A DONATIONS button also appears at the top of the trader screen.

Leaderboards rank every player by rating, kills, K/D, deaths, infected, animals, longest kill, time played or courier deliveries, with a search. Reviews – give another player 1 to 5 stars and a comment, after 30 minutes played. One review per player; saving again replaces it.

Press F9 or Social → Server Info on the tablet : Players online, server time and the next restart. Welcome, rules, wipes, restarts and events. Links Discord, website, store and the Workshop page that open in your browser. The same links are on the tablet's Links button. Your stats and the top 5 players . Admins edit all of it in F8 → INFO .
Social → Notifications turns pop-ups for messages, bank and bounties on or off, each with its own sound. Saved on the server for your account.
Courier contracts Jobs → Contracts EP Courier Co. . Carry a crate from a pickup to a drop-off for pay.

Pick a job from the job board . Pay is per km of the route 4,000 per km by default . TAKE JOB costs a 10% deposit , returned on delivery. The Courier Cargo Crate appears at the pickup. Carry it, or put it in a vehicle not tents, barrels, clothes or the garage . Put it down within 30 m of the drop-off, look at it and use Deliver cargo F . The time limit is 4 minutes per km , plus 10 minutes.
Every running crate shows on every player's map and in the world , with the pay and the courier's name. Everyone is told when a job starts, is delivered, stolen or failed.

Anyone can deliver someone else's crate and gets 70% of the pay; the courier loses the deposit. Whoever carries a crate, rides in its vehicle or stands within 2 m of it can be hurt by other players anywhere , PvE and safe zones included. Whoever hits such a player loses their own PvE protection for 120 seconds . Members of the same Expansion group still can't hurt each other. Note Load @GhostzSuite after @Ninjins-PvP-PvE-Bundle and any other PvE mod, so courier PvP works.

Post your own delivery: the pickup is where you stand, PICK ON MAP sets the drop-off, then set the pay and POST JOB . The pay is held from your bank and a crate appears for you to fill. CANCEL refunds you before anyone takes it.

Jobs → Contracts → QUESTS AND MISSIONS : Every Expansion quest you can do, your running quests, their objectives and rewards. Start and cancel quests from the tablet. Hand in finished quests too, if the admin allows it off by default , with one button per reward choice. Quest money rewards go straight into your bank. Running Expansion missions airdrops, AI missions with difficulty, location, distance and time left. Admins set these in F8 → SETTINGS → QUESTS AND MISSIONS .

Bounties Jobs → Bounties. Admins turn bounties on in F8 → SETTINGS → BOUNTIES ; they're off by default. Post a bounty on any player: a reward from your bank 5,000 to 10,000,000 , a reason and a time limit 1 to 48 hours . New bounties go to every player's inbox with a notification. A hunter takes it by paying a 10% deposit . Kill the target and the hunter is paid reward + deposit . Run out of time and the bounty fails.

Who Marker The wanted player Red skull , seen by everyone 3D for the hunter The hunter Green skull , seen by the target and the poster Admins choose what shows: the red skull to everyone or only to the hunter and poster, the green skull, or neither. Markers move every 5 seconds. The hunter and target can fight each other even on PvE servers. Each bounty shows a picture of the target in their gear.
If the hunter dies, the target keeps the hunter's deposit and the bounty opens again for someone else. If time runs out, the poster gets their reward back.
Admins can post new, taken, paid-out and ended bounties to a Discord channel by webhook each on or off .

Territory rent Every Expansion territory pays rent from the owner's bank, by the size of the base: the number of base-building assets inside it. Base-building assets Rent per day Up to 100 1,000 Up to 300 2,000 Up to 600 3,000 More 5,000 Rent is taken automatically from the owner's bank , one day at a time. If the bank can't pay, every member is warned and gets a 24-hour grace period . After that, the flag is removed . Any member can pay from Territory → Territories PAY 1 DAY / PAY 7 DAYS , from bank or cash, up to 30 days ahead. New territories get their first day free . Players see their bas
Territory control zones Territory → Zones lists every zone, its kind, income, holder and status. Admins set zones up in F8 → CONTROL ZONES .

Zones pay their holders every 24 hours, online or offline , straight into the bank: Kind Income per 24 hours Military base 25,000 City 20,000 Town 15,000 Village 10,000 Industrial 5,000 Every extra zone a group holds adds +10% to all its zone income. Income is split between group members by default. Production: zones can also make items each payout into the holding group's production store. Admins choose the items and amounts per zone kind.

Stay inside for 15 minutes with nobody from another group inside. The holders being inside, or another group walking in, stops the takeover. The holders are warned when a takeover starts, stops and succeeds, and every capture is announced to the server.

Inside a zone, every player can be hurt by other players, ignoring PvE and safe-zone protection. Players get "PVP ZONE – YOU ARE VULNERABLE" when they walk in. Group members still can't hurt each other. Zones are drawn on every player's map: a pin and a ring in the zone's colour, with its name, type and holder. They don't appear in the map's marker list.

Every file is written to a temporary copy, read back and checked, the current file is copied to a verified .bak , and only then is it replaced. A file that can't be read is kept as <file>.broken <date-time> and its backup is loaded instead; it's never reset to empty.

Troubleshooting and FAQ Most problems come from three things: the Expansion ATM being off, a player on an older version than the server, or a market edit that needs a restart. Problem Fix F8 says "Not an admin" Add the Steam64 ID it shows to Admins in Settings.json and restart Shops say the ATM is off, or rent never charges Turn on ATMSystemEnabled in Expansion's MarketSettings.json . Rent pauses while it's off; nothing is deleted Online pay not arriving Check F8 → SETTINGS → ONLINE PAY is on 1 with an amount above 0 Parking zones not on the map Check ShowMapMarkers is 1 and that players have

Can players fake money or items? No. Every price, payment, stock change and spawn is checked and done on the server. What happens to shop stock on a restart? Nothing. Stock lives in the shop's file, not in the world. Do I need to wipe to update? No. Settings and data carry over; new settings appear with their defaults. See Updating . Where do Workshop fees go? They're paid with Expansion Plus money bank or cash, the player's choice and logged in Transactions. Do players need the update too? Yes. The tablet, map drawing and sounds run on each player's game, so players must have the same version
